tom: Heads up — partner webhook vs our ledger for ACME Edge (us-east-1) shows ~12% positive delta aggregated daily for last 3 days. No single big spike, steady offset. Can we triage briefly? I've attached a sample CSV in the ticket. :eyes:

lina: Thanks. Are these from the new minute-stream or the legacy hourly exports? Did we run dedupe on the minute stream yet?

marketplace-bot: webhook error summary:
2026-03-21 23:11:08Z | 409 | duplicate_nonce
2026-03-22 02:05:12Z | 500 | timeout_relay
Recent replay windows: 03/21-03/23

julio: partner sends both minute events + hourly rollups. We only dedupe by event_id; but partner replays can reuse nonce. Proposal: dedupe by (event_id, source_batch_id) and collapse minute -> hourly before ingest. quick SQL sample:
```
SELECT sku, sum(units) FROM partner_events
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-20' GROUP BY sku
```
Not pretty but helps spot double-count.

sridhar: Triaging idea: 1) 24h diff between partner raw events and our normalized ledger. 2) 7d rolling match against invoices. 3) If mismatch > 5% trigger auto-credit/fallback policy. For fallback we should prefer 'ledger conservative' (bill lower) and issue auto-credit once reconciled. Also suggest checksum on partner payload (sha256 of sorted line items).

elaine: Re: sku mapping — partner rolled sku namespace v2->v3 last week; mapping fallback returns null for some appliances (asia-east1). That would route events to default rateplan and inflate usage price. We should apply translation table in normalization layer before aggregation.

tom: Ok, action items: I'll open a tracking ticket + upload sample CSV. @julio can you add `source_batch_id` dedupe and run a replay for 03/20-03/23? @lina can you run the map-fix on STAGING and run the reconcile job? If >5% we'll prepare credit notes. ETA EOD tomorrow? :thumbsup:

tom: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source. I'll post links to PR + ticket when open.
